judgement.reason: Harbor is a stack of cooperating services (core, jobservice, registry, portal, db, log and others) built from separate images, and Deployz runs only one web service per deployment.

evidence.quote: Harbor extends the open source Docker Distribution by adding the functionalities usually required by users such as security, identity and management.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: make/photon/ holds the Dockerfiles of 14 component images (common, core, db, exporter, jobservice, log), so the app is a stack of cooperating services. Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The selected Dockerfile builds only the Harbor portal frontend served by nginx, while the Harbor registry needs its core, jobservice, registry and other component services, and nothing shown proves that the production app works without them.
